title: Identification of a signature gene set for oxaliplatin sensitivity prediction in colorectal cancer.
summary: GEO/TCGA expression analyses and feature selection identified four oxaliplatin-sensitivity genes; external GEO/GDSC validation and gene-silencing cell experiments tested functional contribution. Evidence supports a preclinical gene/signature finding; not prospective patient-level treatment selection.
